DIAGNOSIS READY: Stimulant-Induced Psychotic Disorder (Amphetamine Intoxication)

The clinical picture of aggressive behavior, tachycardia, hyperthermia, and dilated pupils, combined with a confirmed positive amphetamine screen, strongly points to stimulant intoxication. The reported stress and gym activity may be behavioral consequences of the intoxication rather than primary causes. Given the clear evidence of amphetamine use causing these symptoms, further testing is unnecessary.
